newsitem.title: CANADA: CS stock opens higher after bid news.
newsitem.headline: CS stock opens higher after bid news.

text.p: Shares in CS Resources Ltd, which were halted on the Toronto Stock Exchange early on Friday, opened higher after Gulf Canada Resources Ltd announced its intent to launch a takeover bid for the company.
CS opened up 3.20 to 14.50 and later climbed another 0.25 to 14.75, a new year high. By 1255 EDT (1655 GMT), over 202,000 shares had changed hands.
Gulf Canada said earlier today it would offer CS shareholders either C$14.25 in cash, subject to a maximum of C$100 million, or 1.1539 Gulf Canada shares for each CS share.
However, CS said it expected to announce a deal with another "strategic partner." ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
